comment: This is Fugue and Fugue X merged onto one panel for hosts that do not carry expanders; the controls and the behaviour are the same as the two separate modules. The wander is tiered rather than random, and with Harmonic Lock on each voice takes whichever of three candidate notes is most consonant with what the other two are playing.
